published.title: Manasseh's Repentance and Josiah's Reforms
published.summary: Manasseh is taken captive to Babylon, humbles himself, and returns to remove idols. During Josiah’s reign Hilkiah finds the law book; Josiah renews the covenant, keeps a great Passover, and dies fighting Pharaoh Necho.
